note: Bridge claims a reclining arrangement was copied for 350 years and is a body position repeatable by hand. Target article 'aphrodite-painting' is titled 'One Reclining Pose, Copied for 350 Years' and its coreSummary says three Aphrodite paintings 'share a single reclining pose, passed from painter to painter across three and a half centuries'. The by-hand claim is verified in its section 'Manet copies it by hand': 'During a trip to Florence, he made a small painted copy of the Venus of Urbino at the Uffizi itself'. Both assertions hold.
